findings.quote_bytes: derivation: NG7-A4's committed illustration "~5.1 bps over 3 nights" for NZD-USD; 5.1/3 = 1.7 — caveats DISCLOSED: a 3-night cumulative average does NOT bound the single worst night, and NZD-USD-worst is generalized to all five legs without a per-leg differential census, none being derivable from OHLC-only TD
findings.why_wrong: The cycle's central financing number rests on a single committed illustrative byte (one leg, NZD-USD, 3-night cumulative worst-differential illustration). The 5.1/3 division assumes cost linearity in nights and transfers the NZD-worst rate to all five legs. Residual understatement of true financing for a single worst night or an adverse-sign leg is therefore possible and could flip a marginal arm's R1 outcome at E. Mitigation is frozen and complete: the two caveats are disclosed verbatim in §4, the D1 manifest is required to print source bytes + arithmetic + caveats verbatim, §10 mandates the financing disclosure verbatim on any result, the charge is strictly positive and sign-invariant (no favourable credit; dual-books gate non-tautological — inversion occurs exactly when price edge < charge), stress-2.0 is PRIMARY (operative 3.4 bps/session), the M0 degenerate fixture is required, and the single-session law makes one night per trade exact. Corroboration from the authorized evidence space: the A4 dossier (research/control/ng6_ng7_ng4_dossiers_2026-09/fng7-a4-hostile-critic-dossier.json) computes the illustration itself as 6.23%/365 x 3 nights ~ 5.1 bps, so 1.7 bps/night reconstructs the A4 nightly worst-differential rate exactly — the derivation is reconstructive of committed arithmetic, not an invented number. This is a stated-conservative band with a disclosed understatement direction, not a silent zero and not a tautology; it does not change the audit conclusion, so it is MEDIUM, not HIGH.
findings.required_remediation: NONE-BLOCKING. Carry the frozen disclosures verbatim as written. Optional tightening at the D1 freeze: state in the manifest that 1.7 bps/night equals the A4 worst-differential nightly rate (6.23%/365), making the provenance chain explicit.

audit_items_adjudicated.item_1_f4_financing_resolution: SOUND_WITH_DISCLOSED_CAVEATS. (a) Not a silent zero: the band is named, strictly positive (1.7 bps/session; 3.4 stressed), preregistered before any measurement, and charged uniformly across legs regardless of sign, so no leg receives an assumed favourable credit. (b) Not a tautology: financed book = price book + uniform deduction, the books genuinely differ on every arm, and sign inversion occurs exactly when a price edge is smaller than the charge — real discriminative power, fail-closed, with a dedicated M0 degenerate fixture (§9). (c) The single-session law is construction-complete across all five families: entry at bar t+1 open, exit at bar t+1 close crosses exactly one rollover, so exactly one night band per trade is correct; no grid family requires or admits a multi-session hold, so the NG6/NG7 silent-zero class cannot arise. (d) Stress arithmetic verified: 2 x 1.5 x 2.0 + 1.7 x 2.0 = 9.4 bps per round trip; §8 'once per fill / once per session' consistent. (e) Understatement direction (single worst night above the nightly rate; adverse-sign legs undercharged while favourable legs are overcharged) is disclosed verbatim in §4, required verbatim in the D1 manifest, and mandated in §10 result language. (f) Provenance corroborated from authorized bytes: the A4 dossier derives the illustration as 6.23%/365 x 3 nights ~ 5.1 bps, so 5.1/3 = 1.7 recovers the A4 nightly rate exactly. Residual materiality filed as F-1 (MEDIUM).
